claims: Monitor blood glucose closely and manage hyperglycemia with the existing insulin regimen (subcutaneous insulin sliding scale/orders).
Recheck basic metabolic panel including bicarbonate, anion gap, and electrolytes to assess metabolic acidosis and guide bicarbonate/electrolyte replacement.
Continue potassium chloride and magnesium sulfate replacement as ordered, with follow-up electrolyte monitoring.
Continue calcium gluconate and oral calcium/phosphorus repletion for hypocalcemia and hypophosphatemia, with repeat calcium and phosphate levels.
Monitor vital signs and oxygen saturation per ICU protocol, with alarms active for heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and SpO2.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin as ordered.
Maintain IV access and continue isotonic saline flushes/fluids as ordered, monitoring volume status.
Assess and manage pain and nausea with acetaminophen and ondansetron as ordered, reassessing symptoms.
Perform fall and skin integrity risk assessment (Braden) and implement mobility/safety precautions.
Continue home medications (simvastatin, fluoxetine, alprazolam, lamotrigine) and monitor for glycemic and neurologic effects.
